title: Seven and the Ragged Tiger
producer: Alex Sadkin, Ian Little, Duran Duran
studio_context: Produced by the band with Alex Sadkin and Ian Little; The Reflex remixed for the single (1984) by Nile Rodgers and Jason Corsaro.

drum_performances.name: Roger Taylor
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The Reflex: the hat in a sixteenth-note gallop with one hand, the kick on the "a" of 1 and the "and" of 2 in the chorus.
